board: Keyes / Joy-IT KY-032 IR obstacle avoidance module (SEN-KY032IR)
reason: Modelled as an active-low digital output (NE555 38 kHz emitter + HS0038-type receiver driving OUT low on obstacle) with header GND, +, OUT, EN and EN optional (jumper fitted). The example prints 'OUT=0 obstacle=1' with the obstacle toggle on and the part check passes on ESP32 and Pico.
breakoutPinoutSource: Joy-IT SEN-KY032IR manual device overview (1 GND, 2 +, 3 Out, 4 EN active high; EN jumper); https://arduinomodules.info/ky-032-infrared-obstacle-avoidance-sensor-module/ (GND, +, S, EN)
